app.title: FreeThaiOCR
app.tagline: Thai & English OCR that runs entirely in your browser
app.privacy: Your files never leave your device.

upload.title: Drop images, PDFs or a whole folder here
upload.hint: PNG, JPG, WebP, PDF · files are added to a list you can OCR in one go
upload.unsupported: This file type isn't supported. Use an image or a PDF.

features.local: Private: OCR runs on your device
features.box: Draw boxes to read just part of a page
features.pdf: Multi-page PDFs, with embedded text used when present
features.export: Copy, or export TXT, Markdown, JSON or a searchable PDF

toolbar.boxHint: Drag on the page to draw a box

engine.firstTime: First time only: about 8 MB, cached for later and offline use.
engine.error: The OCR engine failed to load: {{error}}
engine.gpuHint: Faster on some devices. Downloads an extra ~4 MB runtime.
engine.gpuUnavailable: WebGPU isn't available in this browser.
engine.documentFirstTime: First time only: about 112 MB (layout and table models), cached for later and offline use.
engine.aksonFirstTime: First time only: about 22 MB, cached for later and offline use.

results.title: Results
results.empty: No text yet. Press “OCR page”, or draw a box.
results.emptyBoxes: No boxes yet. Choose “Draw box” and drag on the page.
results.markdownHint: Read in document mode: headings, paragraphs and tables (HTML) in Markdown

export.completeNote: Pages not read yet are OCR’d first.
export.ocrMissing: Reading pages that have no text yet…
export.encrypted: {{name}} is a protected (encrypted) PDF, so a searchable copy can’t be made. Text and JSON exports still work.

donate.title: Support FreeThaiOCR
donate.body: FreeThaiOCR is free and open source. Donations pay for hosting and development.
donate.saveHint: On a phone: save the image, then choose it from your banking app’s scan screen.

about.title: About FreeThaiOCR
about.body: FreeThaiOCR reads printed Thai and English text. Everything, including the OCR models, runs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
about.limits: Works best on printed documents. Handwriting, photos of signs and decorative fonts read poorly.
about.model: OCR model: OpenThai 2.1 OCR Text by iApp Technology (Apache-2.0), based on PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6 (Apache-2.0).
about.license: FreeThaiOCR is open source under the Apache-2.0 license.
about.akson: Optional engine: AksonOCR-Lite by Teetouch Jaknamon (Remtir), Apache-2.0, run as a 16-bit copy. It builds on PaddlePaddle models (Apache-2.0) and Microsoft Table Transformer (MIT).

settings.title: Settings
settings.openthaiHint: Default. Small (~4 MB) and fast, good on phones.
settings.aksonHint: Reads Thai as whole letter clusters. ~22 MB, slower.
settings.documentHint: Column order, headings and tables, as Markdown. +112 MB, best with a GPU.
settings.documentUnavailable: Document mode needs a computer with 8 GB of memory, or “Use GPU” switched on.
settings.confirmAkson: The first time, about 22 MB of model files download to your browser and stay cached. Your files still never leave your device.
settings.confirmDocument: Document mode downloads about 112 MB of layout and table models the first time and can use close to 1 GB of memory without a GPU. Pages are then read as Markdown with headings and tables.
